confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Sydney guide ranges and crowdsourced price sites, not official surveys. Beer, cocktail and wine were set from published venue ranges rather than direct observation. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Sydney's July (winter) market; no accommodation prices were searched. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure the search surfaced, dated 2026-03-20, which is about seven months older than the generation date; I did not open the RBA page and could not confirm a later rate. The FX is also the basis for the USD conversions, so treat all USD figures as approximate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. The basis is Sydney-specific: restaurant and drink ranges from a February 2026 travel guide, a Sydney cappuccino estimate from Expatistan (May 2026) and a combien-coute.net page citing Numbeo (July 2026), and happy-hour listings used only as a sanity check. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for Sydney in July.
